Hyundai Motor India Launches BAYON Intelligent Utility Vehicle Starting at INR 9,99,900

28 Oct 2026, 08:50 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Auto Desk · Source: www.hyundai.com

3 min read

Key takeawaysHyundai Motor India Limited (HMIL) has officially launched its new intelligent utility vehicle, the Hyundai BAYON, at a starting price of INR 9,99,900 (ex-showroom). Hyundai Motor India Limited (HMIL) has officially launched its new intelligent utility vehicle, the Hyundai BAYON, at a starting price of INR 9,99,900 (ex-showroom). Built around the corporate philosophy of "Intelligence That Moves," the vehicle is manufactured in India and is slated for export to more than 50 global markets.

Performance and Powertrain

The Hyundai BAYON is powered by a four-cylinder 1.5L MPi petrol engine that delivers 84.4 kW (115 PS) of maximum power and 143.8 Nm of torque. Buyers can choose between a 6-speed manual transmission (6MT) and an Intelligent Variable Transmission (iVT). Models equipped with the iVT feature additional driver-focused configurations, including Dash Boost Mode for enhanced responsiveness during passing maneuvers and Sporty Drive Tech for more engaging acceleration. The vehicle also provides selectable drive modes (Eco, Normal, and Sport) alongside paddle shifters and Idle Stop & Go (ISG) functionality.

Technology and Interior Integration

A notable highlight of the BAYON is the inclusion of HMIL's first-ever Generative AI Voice Assistant, combining Intelligence by Perplexity and Voice AI powered by SoundHound AI. This system supports natural conversations for real-time travel, weather, news, and other information queries alongside over 500 embedded voice commands.

The cockpit is anchored by a Connected Car Navigation Cockpit (ccNC) accelerated by NVIDIA, featuring dual 62.5 cm (12.3-inch + 12.3-inch) curved panoramic displays. The vehicle supports Hyundai Bluelink with over 70 connected features, three years of complimentary subscription, wireless Android Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, and up to 19 controllers for Over-the-Air (C-OTA) updates.

Safety and Structural Design

The BAYON is built on the Global K Enhanced Platform, engineered to meet 5-star Indian safety standards. Its body structure incorporates 69% advanced multi-grade high-strength steel utilizing hot stamping and ultra-high-strength steel. The vehicle is equipped with Hyundai SmartSense Level 2 Pro ADAS, offering 23 advanced driver assistance features supported by three radars and twelve parking sensors. Over 35 safety features—including six airbags, Electronic Stability Control (ESC), Hill-start Assist Control (HAC), and a Tyre Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS)—are provided as standard across all variants.

Dimensions and Practical Implications

Measuring 4,245 mm in length, 1,810 mm in width, and 1,605 mm in height with a 2,600 mm wheelbase, the BAYON offers a ground clearance of 205 mm and a boot space of 505 liters. Comfort amenities across trims include front-row ventilated seats, an electric 8-way adjustable driver seat, two-step rear reclining seats, rear AC vents, a panoramic sunroof, and a wireless smartphone charger.

Verified Facts versus Unknowns

  • Confirmed: The starting price is INR 9,99,900 (ex-showroom). The vehicle features a 1.5L MPi petrol engine with 6MT and iVT options, Perplexity and SoundHound AI integration, and Level 2 Pro ADAS.
  • Unknown: Specific variant-wise pricing breakdowns, exact delivery timelines, and detailed fuel efficiency figures across all configurations were not provided in the primary announcement.

Readers can verify official specifications, color options, and complete variant details directly through the Hyundai India Press Release.
